name: Manifest migration (migrate_from and migrate_to)
plain: A site can move people from an old installed app identity to a new one.
meaning: Moving an installed app to a new origin normally means a fresh install. These members let the browser carry the install over and, by doing so, reveal the old app identity.

web.api: manifest.migrate_from (id and start_url of the old app); manifest.migrate_to

access.prompt_ui: A consent flow per the spec

chrome.note: migrate_from and migrate_to from 149 on desktop

data.metric: A site can move people from an old installed app identity to a new one.

fields.name: migrate_from
fields.range: old app id and start URL

limits.headline: Can move an installed app to a new address, if the browser and you agree
limits.user_action: None, the page reads it silently
can: Carry an install from one origin to another
Name the old identity it replaces
cannot: Move data without a consent step
limits.differs: Chromium only. Spec details are medium confidence.

story.what_it_is: A site can hand an installed app over to a new address without a new install.

marketing.name: Manifest incubations
marketing.pitch: Proposals for manifest features beyond the core spec.

story.for_you: If a company changes its web address you may be offered a smooth move instead of installing again.
story.for_makers: Makers who rebrand or change domains keep their installed base.

use_cases.example: A store moves its installed app to a new domain after a rebrand.
